----- components/Tombol.tsx -----
// Generated by Lakar from component "Tombol". Import tokens.css once in your app.
import type { CSSProperties } from 'react';
import styles from './Tombol.module.css';

export type TombolProps = {
  label?: string;
  showIcon?: boolean;
  icon?: "arrow-right" | "download" | "play";
  className?: string;
  style?: CSSProperties;
};

export function Tombol({ label = "Button", showIcon = true, icon = "arrow-right", className, style }: TombolProps) {
  return (
    <div className={`${styles.tombol}${className ? ` ${className}` : ''}`} style={style}>
      <div className={styles.label}>
        {label}
      </div>
      {showIcon && (
        <div className={styles.iconLucideArrowRight}>
          {icon === "arrow-right" && (
            <svg className={styles.iconLucideArrowRightSvg} viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
              <path d="M5 12h14" />
              <path d="m12 5 7 7-7 7" />
            </svg>
          )}
          {icon === "download" && (
            <svg className={styles.iconLucideArrowRightSvg2} viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
              <path d="M12 15V3" />
              <path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4" />
              <path d="m7 10 5 5 5-5" />
            </svg>
          )}
          {icon === "play" && (
            <svg className={styles.iconLucideArrowRightSvg3} viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
              <path d="M5 5a2 2 0 0 1 3.008-1.728l11.997 6.998a2 2 0 0 1 .003 3.458l-12 7A2 2 0 0 1 5 19z" />
            </svg>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default Tombol;

----- components/Fitur.tsx -----
// Generated by Lakar from component "Fitur". Import tokens.css once in your app.
import type { CSSProperties, ReactNode } from 'react';
import styles from './Fitur.module.css';

export type FiturProps = {
  title?: string;
  desc?: string;
  icon?: "zap" | "shield" | "sparkles";
  highlight?: boolean;
  aksi?: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  style?: CSSProperties;
};

export function Fitur({ title = "Feature", desc = "Describe the feature in one or two short lines.", icon = "zap", highlight = false, aksi, className, style }: FiturProps) {
  return (
    <div className={`${styles.fitur}${className ? ` ${className}` : ''}`} style={style}>
      <div className={styles.ikon}>
        <div className={styles.iconLucideZap}>
          {icon === "zap" && (
            <svg className={styles.iconLucideZapSvg} viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
              <path d="M15.914 4a1.5 1.5 0 00-2.474-1.561l-9 9A1.5 1.5 0 005.5 14h4.002a.5.5 0 01.471.666L8.086 20a1.5 1.5 0 002.475 1.56l9-9A1.5 1.5 0 0018.5 10h-3.997a.5.5 0 01-.472-.667z" />
            </svg>
          )}
          {icon === "shield" && (
            <svg className={styles.iconLucideZapSvg2} viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
              <path d="M20 13c0 5-3.5 7.5-7.66 8.95a1 1 0 0 1-.67-.01C7.5 20.5 4 18 4 13V6a1 1 0 0 1 1-1c2 0 4.5-1.2 6.24-2.72a1.17 1.17 0 0 1 1.52 0C14.51 3.81 17 5 19 5a1 1 0 0 1 1 1z" />
            </svg>
          )}
          {icon === "sparkles" && (
            <svg className={styles.iconLucideZapSvg3} viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
              <path d="M11.017 2.814a1 1 0 0 1 1.966 0l1.051 5.558a2 2 0 0 0 1.594 1.594l5.558 1.051a1 1 0 0 1 0 1.966l-5.558 1.051a2 2 0 0 0-1.594 1.594l-1.051 5.558a1 1 0 0 1-1.966 0l-1.051-5.558a2 2 0 0 0-1.594-1.594l-5.558-1.051a1 1 0 0 1 0-1.966l5.558-1.051a2 2 0 0 0 1.594-1.594z" />
              <path d="M20 2v4" />
              <path d="M22 4h-4" />
              <circle cx="4" cy="20" r="2" />
            </svg>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.judul}>
        {title}
      </div>
      <div className={styles.deskripsi}>
        {desc}
      </div>
      <div className={styles.aksi}>
        {aksi ?? (
          <>
            <div className={styles.tautan}>
              Learn more
            </div>
            <div className={styles.iconLucideArrowRight}>
              <svg className={styles.iconLucideArrowRightSvg} viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
                <path d="M5 12h14" />
                <path d="m12 5 7 7-7 7" />
              </svg>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
      {highlight && (
        <div className={styles.lencana}>
          <div className={styles.lencana2}>
            New
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default Fitur;

----- components/Tombol.tsx -----
// Generated by Lakar from component "Tombol". Import tokens.css once in your app.
import type { CSSProperties } from 'react';
import styles from './Tombol.module.css';

export type TombolProps = {
  label?: string;
  showIcon?: boolean;
  icon?: "arrow-right" | "download" | "play";
  className?: string;
  style?: CSSProperties;
};

export function Tombol({ label = "Button", showIcon = true, icon = "arrow-right", className, style }: TombolProps) {
  return (
    <div className={`${styles.tombol}${className ? ` ${className}` : ''}`} style={style}>
      <div className={styles.label}>
        {label}
      </div>
      {showIcon && (
        <div className={styles.iconLucideArrowRight}>
          {icon === "arrow-right" && (
            <svg className={styles.iconLucideArrowRightSvg} viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
              <path d="M5 12h14" />
              <path d="m12 5 7 7-7 7" />
            </svg>
          )}
          {icon === "download" && (
            <svg className={styles.iconLucideArrowRightSvg2} viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
              <path d="M12 15V3" />
              <path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4" />
              <path d="m7 10 5 5 5-5" />
            </svg>
          )}
          {icon === "play" && (
            <svg className={styles.iconLucideArrowRightSvg3} viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
              <path d="M5 5a2 2 0 0 1 3.008-1.728l11.997 6.998a2 2 0 0 1 .003 3.458l-12 7A2 2 0 0 1 5 19z" />
            </svg>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default Tombol;

// Generated by Lakar from component "Fitur". Import tokens.css once in your app.
import type { CSSProperties, ReactNode } from 'react';
import styles from './Fitur.module.css';

export type FiturProps = {
  title?: string;
  desc?: string;
  icon?: "zap" | "shield" | "sparkles";
  highlight?: boolean;
  aksi?: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  style?: CSSProperties;
};

export function Fitur({ title = "Feature", desc = "Describe the feature in one or two short lines.", icon = "zap", highlight = false, aksi, className, style }: FiturProps) {
  return (
    <div className={`${styles.fitur}${className ? ` ${className}` : ''}`} style={style}>
      <div className={styles.ikon}>
        <div className={styles.iconLucideZap}>
          {icon === "zap" && (
            <svg className={styles.iconLucideZapSvg} viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
              <path d="M15.914 4a1.5 1.5 0 00-2.474-1.561l-9 9A1.5 1.5 0 005.5 14h4.002a.5.5 0 01.471.666L8.086 20a1.5 1.5 0 002.475 1.56l9-9A1.5 1.5 0 0018.5 10h-3.997a.5.5 0 01-.472-.667z" />
            </svg>
          )}
          {icon === "shield" && (
            <svg className={styles.iconLucideZapSvg2} viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
              <path d="M20 13c0 5-3.5 7.5-7.66 8.95a1 1 0 0 1-.67-.01C7.5 20.5 4 18 4 13V6a1 1 0 0 1 1-1c2 0 4.5-1.2 6.24-2.72a1.17 1.17 0 0 1 1.52 0C14.51 3.81 17 5 19 5a1 1 0 0 1 1 1z" />
            </svg>
          )}
          {icon === "sparkles" && (
            <svg className={styles.iconLucideZapSvg3} viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
              <path d="M11.017 2.814a1 1 0 0 1 1.966 0l1.051 5.558a2 2 0 0 0 1.594 1.594l5.558 1.051a1 1 0 0 1 0 1.966l-5.558 1.051a2 2 0 0 0-1.594 1.594l-1.051 5.558a1 1 0 0 1-1.966 0l-1.051-5.558a2 2 0 0 0-1.594-1.594l-5.558-1.051a1 1 0 0 1 0-1.966l5.558-1.051a2 2 0 0 0 1.594-1.594z" />
              <path d="M20 2v4" />
              <path d="M22 4h-4" />
              <circle cx="4" cy="20" r="2" />
            </svg>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.judul}>
        {title}
      </div>
      <div className={styles.deskripsi}>
        {desc}
      </div>
      <div className={styles.aksi}>
        {aksi ?? (
          <>
            <div className={styles.tautan}>
              Learn more
            </div>
            <div className={styles.iconLucideArrowRight}>
              <svg className={styles.iconLucideArrowRightSvg} viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
                <path d="M5 12h14" />
                <path d="m12 5 7 7-7 7" />
              </svg>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
      {highlight && (
        <div className={styles.lencana}>
          <div className={styles.lencana2}>
            New
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default Fitur;

----- components/Tombol.tsx -----
// Generated by Lakar from component "Tombol". Import tokens.css once in your app.
import type { CSSProperties } from 'react';
import styles from './Tombol.module.css';

export type TombolProps = {
  label?: string;
  showIcon?: boolean;
  icon?: "arrow-right" | "download" | "play";
  className?: string;
  style?: CSSProperties;
};

export function Tombol({ label = "Button", showIcon = true, icon = "arrow-right", className, style }: TombolProps) {
  return (
    <div className={`${styles.tombol}${className ? ` ${className}` : ''}`} style={style}>
      <div className={styles.label}>
        {label}
      </div>
      {showIcon && (
        <div className={styles.iconLucideArrowRight}>
          {icon === "arrow-right" && (
            <svg className={styles.iconLucideArrowRightSvg} viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
              <path d="M5 12h14" />
              <path d="m12 5 7 7-7 7" />
            </svg>
          )}
          {icon === "download" && (
            <svg className={styles.iconLucideArrowRightSvg2} viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
              <path d="M12 15V3" />
              <path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4" />
              <path d="m7 10 5 5 5-5" />
            </svg>
          )}
          {icon === "play" && (
            <svg className={styles.iconLucideArrowRightSvg3} viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
              <path d="M5 5a2 2 0 0 1 3.008-1.728l11.997 6.998a2 2 0 0 1 .003 3.458l-12 7A2 2 0 0 1 5 19z" />
            </svg>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default Tombol;
